# Bet Max Action

> Social sports gaming that scales. Bet Max Tourney and Bet Max Partner Tools for branded tournaments, player engagement, and API integration.

Bet Max Tourney is the consumer app for free social sports betting, public tournaments, private pools, and live Leaderboards. Tournament Dollars (TD$) are in-game scoring units.

Bet Max Partner Tools covers tournament management, player management, branding, rewards, and the Bet Max API. Partners can use a hosted app, embed branded tournament cards that lead into the hosted app, or build their own interface through the API. Paid entry requires a separately scoped wallet integration and operator compliance approval.

The current Partner Tools page is /partner-tools/.

## Products and Partner Programs

- [Bet Max Action](https://betmaxaction.com/): Social sports gaming and partner programs.
- [Bet Max Tourney](https://betmaxaction.com/bet-max-tourney/): The app experience, game formats, sports, and partner opportunities.
- [Bet Max Partner Tools](https://betmaxaction.com/partner-tools/): Integration options, branded examples, tournament tools, player management, and API access.
- [Casino Operators](https://betmaxaction.com/casino-operators/): Branded tournaments and integration options for casino operators.
- [Sports Industry Partners](https://betmaxaction.com/sports-industry-partners/): Sports industry relationships and brand licensing opportunities.
